title: myrceugenia ovata var. regnelliana
intro: Myrceugenia ovata var. regnelliana, commonly known as the "Brazilian guava", is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Myrceugenia ovata var. regnelliana include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which are present in its leaves and other parts of the plant.
